senses.gloss: नीच- + कुल नीच- + कुल, n. a low family, Mṛcch. 83, 8.

निचय निचय, i. e. नि-चि + अ, m.
 1. Heaping, Rām. 2, 77, 22.
 2. Collection, MBh. 15, 205.
 3. Heap, multitude, 4, 30.
 4. Provision. 11, 48.
 5. The parts (of a whole), 15, 5416.
निचुल निचुल, m. A tree, Barringtonia acutangula Gaertn., Rām. 3, 17, 7.
निचोल निचोल, m. A cover, a wrapper, Rājat. 3, 169.
निच्छिवि निच्छिवि, m. The name of a mixed class: the son of a Vrātya Kṣatriya, Man. 10, 22.

नीच नीच, i. e. नि-अञ्च् + अ, adj., f. चा.
 1. Low, Man. 2, 198.
 2. Short, Yājñ. 1, 131.
 3. Deep, Pañc. i. d. 225.
 4. Base, mean, Rām. 3, 35, 35.
 5. ˚चैस्, instr. pl., adv.
 1. Below, Megh. 43.
 2. Low-bowing, MBh. 1, 3287.
 3. Little, Ragh. 3, 43.
 4. Humbly, Kām. Nītis. 7, 42.
 5. Softly, Amar. 67.
 --Comp.
नीचक नी-च + क, adj., f. चिका, Soft, MBh. 3, 11018.
नीचता नीच + ता, f. Inferiority, MBh. 3, 10635.

नीचीन नीचीन, i. e. नि-अञ्च् + ईन, adj.
 1. Downward, cast down, Bhāg. P. 8, 22, 14.
 2. Flowing down, 5, 16, 25.
